gloss: A philosophical relation, not itself a formal claim: the formal content lives in the score and diachronic constructions, so nothing here is checkable beyond the blurb's characterization.
The blurb calls it the relation the whole program builds, and the score, diachronic and record constructions all define themselves against it; four map links bear that out.
One crisp sentence (the standing to be asked for reasons, to give them, to be corrected on them) but no longer-form page; the moment/history split is stated, not developed here.

A finite model with the committive/permissive/incompatibility separation (wiki Reasons-Answerability-and-the-Score); paper-derived with merged work behind it, no registered kernel-checked claim named on the page.
The static question the learning line presupposes: what makes a response assessable at all. Four tagged merged PRs show it carrying real work.
The wiki page states the three relations and that applicability is itself contestable content; crisp, though the score-as-quantity step is thinner than the relations.

The standard instrumental-preservation argument (Omohundro 2008 §2; Soares et al. 2015): well-argued and widely accepted, but 'almost all rational agents' is a heuristic claim, not a theorem at this generality.
The obstacle the corrigibility line exists to answer; the kernel and value-change-as-belief-change are both framed against it.
The backing claim states the mechanism (preserve preferences, hence resist modification) in one sentence; 'almost all' hides the quantifier that matters.
A published structured-argumentation framework (Modgil & Prakken) with worked-out semantics and rationality postulates; established formal work, inherited rather than re-proved here.
A comparison ancestor: the blurb uses it to name exactly the two things the defeat theory adds (authored attacks, debts passing to successors).
Attack and defeat computed by a semantics over arguments is a precise published definition; the blurb's contrast with this repository's additions is exact.
Oesterheld, Demski & Conitzer 2023, published with proofs: never overestimate options, cover hypotheses, payoff guarantee. The recorded myopia obstacle is in the source too.
The BRIA line (continuation BRIA, the constitutional gate) is built directly on it; its myopia is the stated thing the program works past.
The three conditions and the guarantee are stated precisely in the paper; the blurb compresses them faithfully.
Garrabrant's published sequence develops the algebra with proofs; stable formal work, used here as background.
Background for where-the-agent-ends questions; two map links and no construction here consumes it directly.
Factor a world into agent and environment as two sets and a matrix is an exact definition, and the sequence develops it carefully.
Le Cam's contiguity is classical probability theory; the repository argues from the definition directly rather than citing folklore.
One map link: a genuine but narrow dependency of the convergence-transfer results.
The condition (convergence under one sequence of measures transfers to another) is standard and precisely stated in any reference.
The wiki names a Lean core (ContinuationBRIA.lean) and a consolidating round; kernel-checked center with surrounding claims at paper strength.
The deference line's lift from single choices to courses of action without counterfactual reward tables; five links and five tagged merged PRs.
The canonical wiki page states the lift and what is not surrendered (the constitutional gate); long but organized.
The projection theorem and its variational inequality are textbook convex analysis; the blurb is explicit that enforcement genuinely depends on it.
Enforcement moves prices by projection, so the inequality sits inside the program's central mechanism, though as inherited mathematics.
Nearest point of a convex set and the characterizing inequality: one exact statement, no drift.

The blurb presents it as the proved headline (faithfulness of the policy with its pre-emption clause); kernel-checked per the corrigibility line's record, with the definitional choices doing real work.
The corrigibility line's headline: every loss to a protected concern authorized and traceable. What the line is for.
Stated as faithfulness with a pre-emption clause; crisp once response authority is in hand, which is a real prerequisite.
One Lean file, every post item mapped to a kernel-checked, sorry-free declaration with source links (wiki companion page); each theorem registered.
The public post's formal backbone and the corrigibility line's statement of record; the bridge a reader checks the post against.
The companion's tables (post item, post notation, Lean declaration, source line) are as unambiguous as the format allows.
A design commitment of the defeat theory (disposal hands the debt to a named successor); coherent with the Integrity conservation results but not itself presented with a checked statement here.
The move that makes history matter (the future depends on which arguments lost); five map links into the record and defeat layers.
The blurb's answered-or-carried disjunction is clean, but there is no longer-form statement of the successor discipline to pin it down.
The corpus closes the Total Trust-Value-Tower triangle with direct arrows and a counterexample for tower-to-Value under selection-referencing questions; corpus results are Lean-checked.
What iterated self-trust buys is the deference line's organizing question, and the failure direction is as load-bearing as the arrows.
The triangle picture with one named failure mode is a crisp summary of a technical corpus.
The backing claim states an attained bound (beats any measurable comparator by the grade margin less twice eta on the disagreement region); proved in the deference corpus.
The finite bridge between delegation and deference; one link, consumed by the line rather than the whole program.
The statement quantifies everything it uses (grade trust, admissible partition, disagreement region) and even names tightness.
Brandom's Making It Explicit is developed, influential philosophy, and contested as philosophy is; the repository takes the bookkeeping shape only, which is the defensible part.
The record's conceptual ancestor: commitment/entitlement tracking is the shape the normative record mechanizes; four map links.
A norm exists because a practice tracks who is committed and entitled to what is a slogan for a large theory; the page-level content here stays at that altitude.
Wiki status: canonical, derived; the decomposition theorem (content conservation from Integrity, standing and access from Robust Openness) is Established lean-proved.
The program's temporal headline: what an open Integrity ledger yields over a history. Sixteen tagged merged PRs is the heaviest work concentration on the map.
The page is explicit that this is not a conjunct of legitimacy but a derived property, which is exactly the confusion it exists to kill.
A hypothesized failure mode (Hubinger et al. 2019's deceptive alignment, here in value-learning form): plausible mechanism, no established instance at the capability level the statement contemplates.
One of the three risk stories the plan answers; the broad-prior corruption route is what the guarantees must survive.
The v2 statement names the full causal chain (gain weight by predicting well, then corrupt before guarantees bind, e.g. a false report enabling takeover).
A stated direction (deference moving with the quantity of evidence about the deferred-to process) without a formal statement or checked result visible from the map.
One link; a refinement of the deference line rather than something the line stands on.
The blurb poses the question cleanly but 'rational amount' is doing undefined work until a statement exists.
Jackson 1955; the exchange argument is classical scheduling theory and the repository writes it out in four lines rather than citing it blind.
One link: it serves the serviceability layer's optimality claim and nothing else.
Serve the oldest deadline first, optimal by exchange: fully specified in one line.
Twelve proved theorems (authority and sincerity conditions) jointly establishing one deference-line claim; the modelling choices (queue, discounts, revocation default) are where the risk lives.
Makes 'standing is real rather than nominal' checkable inside the deference line; two links.
The backing statement is one long conjunction of modelling devices; honest, but a reader must hold six mechanisms to parse the claim.
The three core results are kernel-checked per the blurb and the normativity registry; the compiler as a whole is architecture around them, with typed outcomes.
How an obligation becomes a price movement is the program's central mechanism; seven map links, the most of any construction.
Compile an obligation into a projection onto the allowed region, outcome typed so nothing owed disappears: a crisp mechanism statement.
Raz's category is standard jurisprudence; the close reading here (exclusion as setting aside, not settling) is an interpretive claim the program adopts.
The set-aside/settle distinction propagates into the settlement interface and defeat theory; three links.
A reason not to act on certain other reasons is Raz's own crisp formulation, and the adopted distinction is stated plainly.
The tower mathematics behind it is corpus-proved, but faithfulness of the accelerated run is the construction's open hypothesis rather than a result.
The deference corpus's self-referential target: defer to a faster run of your own deliberation is the use case the line is for.
Frozen deliberation as the fixed point is suggestive; what 'stays faithful' demands is exactly the part without a crisp public statement.
Farkas' lemma and LP duality are classical; the repository's soundness proof is four self-contained lines, with duality proper used only for exactness under a Slater point.
One link: certificate machinery for the enforcement layer's infeasibility claims.
The blurb is unusually precise about which part is used where, which is the clarity that matters for an inherited tool.
The backing claim (a price constraint compiles to a legal trading strategy giving per-date conformance within a schedule, LI criterion preserved) is proved in the traderized construction.
The program's finite-time strengthening of logical induction's limit-only promise; what makes the foundation usable on dates.
The statement names the mechanism, the bound's form and what is preserved; schedule details carry the fine print.
Walley-style imprecise probability is an established theory with coherent upper/lower previsions; inherited here as the state space.
The enforcement mechanism works on exactly these convex sets, so the formalism choice is load-bearing for the central line.
Belief as a convex set of distributions with coherent bounds is a precise, standard definition.
Bostrom 2012 / Omohundro 2008: a widely endorsed heuristic argument with formal versions only in narrow settings; the 'or' statement here is faithful to that strength.
One of the three risk stories and the engine behind corrigibility's anti-naturality, which the whole corrigibility line answers.
The backing statement gives the mechanism and scope hedges exactly as the sources do.
Wiki status: conservation, propagation, receipt immutability, faithful carry and the multiplicity witness all Established lean-proved; protocol predicates are typed inputs, stated as such.
The record's conservation law is what everything diachronic rests on; the page's own argument (a trajectory that rewrites its past escapes anything) is the program's crux.
One-line law (satisfied, disposed of, or still outstanding - nothing vanishes) plus an explicit list of what is proved and what is typed input.
Gale-Hoffman / Horn 1974, cited rather than re-proved; classical feasibility theory.
One link: the serviceability layer's feasibility test.
When jobs with release times and deadlines can all be scheduled is exactly the theorem's scope.
Wiki status: open/unregistered realization material, except the three narrow enforcement results, which are lean-proved and registered; the affordability theory on top is not established.
It is how a realization produces the bounded-liability hypothesis of the conditional Normative Inductor theorem - the central theorem's supply line.
The page's status paragraph separates the proved narrow results from the open theory precisely; 'what does the making cost' states the question well.
Garrabrant et al. 2016: published, heavily scrutinized, with the criterion and construction fully formal; the repository builds on the pinned corpus rather than a paraphrase.
The foundation: the market, traders and criterion are what enforcement, traderization and the inductor are built on. Ten map links, the most of any object.
The criterion (no polynomial-time trader makes unbounded profit) is exact; the deference wiki page honestly flags the self-reference subtleties that make naive readings wrong.
Wiki status: the three narrow enforcement results Established lean-proved; the action theory over them open/unregistered. The score reflects the open part the concept names.
Force as what enforcement does to prices gives the philosophical question a mechanism; it enters the canonical theory only as the uptake certificate.
The page states its own split (proved mechanism, open action theory) and the force/intensity/uptake distinctions cleanly.

Wiki status: the substrate (LI over an assessment process, projection enforcement, preservation under bounded liability, deductive end-to-end) Established lean-proved; the composing theorems are Lean-proved but deliberately unregistered, one with uninhabited hypotheses, and the registered consolidated theorem is conditional on one market.
The central machine the program is building; five links, six tagged merged PRs, and the architecture every other line feeds.
The page's layered status (canonical architecture, conditional theorems, what is registered and why not) is honest and detailed; the name is marked provisional.

A working architecture (afoundational seed, pre-licensed induction, genealogical answerability) with the formal content distributed to Integrity and the interface pages rather than one checked statement of its own.
The left side of everything: what was asked, by whom, on what evidence. The learning loop and the inductor both consume it; five links, five tagged merged PRs.
The pipeline diagram and the one-primitive-induction rule state the architecture plainly for a 24k-character page.

The backing frame states a theorem over the Due/Licensed/Loss interface via a protocol-legal loss-blind compiler, but the interpretation clause (once filing and exposure connect) marks the gap between result and reading.
The learning claim itself: immanent self-correction is what the practice is for; eight tagged merged PRs.
The wiki's pipeline (failure pattern to lesson, with 'lesson' deliberately last) is a careful statement of what is and is not claimed.
Standard jurisprudence (authority as standing to change what someone owes); the repository's move of making it record-statable is design, not yet a checked result named here.
Feeds the effective-authority layer and the licence chain; four links.
The standing-to-change-obligations versus power-to-change-behaviour contrast is stated exactly.
Wiki status: open/unregistered realization material, with the core finite bound on accounted export established; the page is the fixed-era instance of a statement that lives elsewhere.
The statistic normative induction optimizes against; whether the practice improves must be measurable for the learning claim to mean anything.
The page works hard on the word (repeated failures must lose weight, not 'gets better at a task') and names its own instance relation.
A framing commitment: reasons as record content with enforcement behind them, not an unexplained primitive. The commitment is implemented elsewhere; nothing here is itself checkable.
What the practice tracks, weighs and answers; the vocabulary every construction uses.
Considerations that count for or against is the standard gloss; the page-level content stays at blurb altitude.
Horty 2012 is worked-out formal theory (default logic with priorities as normative content); the limits the blurb names (no debts, forgets which arguments lost) are accurate readings.
The nearest static ancestor of the defeat theory; what the successor discipline is measured against.
The blurb states both the inheritance and the two precise shortfalls that motivated departing from it.
Pollock's distinction is stable, formalized across argumentation theory, and used here with its standard content.
Moved from belief justification to the standing of a debt, it structures the defeat theory's attack vocabulary.
Attack the conclusion or attack the support itself: the crispest distinction in the inherited vocabulary.

The joint failure is established: strong reflection fails for fallible experts (Gaifman-style results), weak reflection cannot exclude anti-experts; both are in the deference literature the corpus cites.
The negative space that motivates the decision-based account; three links.
Both principles and both failure modes are stated in one breath each.

A definitional primitive (present-tense standing to respond in a way that counts) from which agent-caused loss and corrigibility are defined; the definitions are formal, the choice of primitive is the bet.
Corrigibility itself is defined from it in this line; if the primitive is wrong the kernel is about the wrong thing.
The question form (can the principal still respond, now?) is evocative but the concept's content lives in the Lean definitions, not on the page.
The backing claim is a proved equivalence on the legitimacy spine (the split bill is Robust Openness itself, split on liveness at the actual prefix), recorded as such.
The standing-and-access half of what diachronic answerability is derived from.
The statement is exact but the split-bill vocabulary demands the spine's context; dense even by this map's standard.
The wiki names the Lean declarations as the statements of record and defers to the claims registry for what is registered; three-layer seed with proved price-forcing content.
What a reasoner starts from, made concrete; consumed by the record line, one map link.
The three layers and the port/strength structure are laid out concretely with the governing registry named.
Wiki status: open/unregistered, paper-derived with exact rational fixtures from a merged round that registers no claim; closed for sequencing is explicitly not an evidence class.
How a realization services what the theory exports; six tagged merged PRs of real work, but realization material by its own page.
The status paragraph distinguishing sequencing-closed from established is a model of the register this map wants.
Six conditions each with exactly one home, four as typed protocol inputs and two as consequences of theorems proved elsewhere; the page exists to prevent a merged 'settlement integrity' hypothesis.
Where the record meets settled is what legitimacy's history statements quantify over; a wrong interface would corrupt every downstream theorem.
The full-history/settlement-view distinction and the one-home-per-condition rule are stated with no residue.
The decision-based definition is precise and the finite two-option identity connecting it to Value is proved in the corpus; broader readings (quantifier domain) carry disclosed modelling choices.
The deference line's precise target: trust a process totally when you would take its advice on every bet it would change.
The definition is one sentence and operational; the subtleties live in which bets are quantified over, which the corpus pages disclose.

The move has multiple kernel-checked instances (finite-date conformance, enforcement preservation): write the condition as a trader and inexploitability enforces it. As a general pattern it is as strong as its instances.
The repository's signature move and the reason the LI foundation pays rent everywhere; it is how conditions become enforced.
Violating the condition is exploitable, so the market enforces it for free - the mechanism in one line.
Doyle 1979 and de Kleer's ATMS are classical, implemented, well-documented systems; inherited as structural ancestry.
The record's structural ancestor (track why each belief is held); one link, no construction consumes it directly.
Support tracking with withdrawal and multiple stances is exactly what those systems do.
Updateless decision theory is an influential informal framework with known formalization gaps (logical counterfactuals); no canonical theorem-level statement exists to check.
One side of the program's stance crux; four links show it genuinely read against the constructions.
Choose the policy before the observations is clear as a slogan; what counts as the policy space and the embedding is the famously under-specified part.
A thesis under test in the corrigibility notes: if value change is belief change, anti-naturality dissolves. Currently a bet with formal scaffolding, not a result.
The corrigibility line's wager; if it holds, the standard obstacle is reframed rather than fought.
The thesis is one sentence, but 'represent values as beliefs' admits readings from trivial to false, and the notes have not yet pinned one.
Standard epistemology (defeasible licence versus indefeasible entailment), used with its standard content and turned into record structure by the licence chain.
The thing the licence chain is about; two links.
A licence you can undercut or rebut, where an entailment you cannot: the inherited distinction is exact.
The backing claim is proved end to end as one theorem, with the supported-to-admissible step by rational convexity rather than projection - a named proof route, not a gesture.
The chain from announced verdict back to grounds is what makes a verdict auditable; the licence vocabulary the authority layer consumes.
The statement defines licence, support and admissibility in sequence; dense but complete.

A representation theorem for when a physical system is a logical inductor would ground the whole program's idealizations, but nothing else on the map currently consumes it; it is an arc, not a dependency.
The three deliverables (representation theorem, decision theory inside it, scale-free agency) are named, but no wiki page fixes what would count as proving any of them.
Whether a verdict is the principal's own program's, through declared channels, is what the effective-authority sincerity conditions need; one line's supply, not the program's.
The lie-through-declared-channel versus sincere-error contrast pins the question unusually well for a thread without a longer page.
One of the program's two public-facing answers (with legitimacy) to the question the top frame asks; the kernel theorem, continuation BRIA and the Deconfusing Corrigibility companion all hang here.
The wiki page and the blurb state the line's architecture (response authority to kernel to learning layer) in one breath; the open parts are marked.
What should an LI-based agent do is the question the deference and BRIA work feeds; the stated end (market and choice learner not two parts) would reorganize several lines.
The question is sharp but the thread has no wiki page and its success criterion (one part, not two) is a direction rather than a statement.
Leaning on a better-informed process without losing correction is half the top question; the corpus (Total Trust, towers, delegation, authority) is the largest proved body on the map.
The wiki page separates the trust relations explicitly; 'trust covers several different relations' is the line's own organizing claim and it is kept.
Standing rather than compliance is the program's distinctive move, and its two halves (Integrity, warrants) carry most of the kernel-checked record.
Record half and licence half, each with named theorems; the cleanest line statement on the map.
The quantitative thread: without Progress and its bounds the learning claims stay qualitative; the central conditional theorem consumes it.
The wiki page states the statistic, the certificate and the leak bound as three deliverables with their status marked.
The line the Normative Inductor lives in: obligation, answer and enforcement as machine-checkable structure is the program's core construction site.
The against-external-scoring framing is stated plainly; the line's breadth (record, enforcement, learning) makes its edges softer than legitimacy's.
Staying correctable by uncaptured parties is what makes the rest non-circular; Robust Openness feeds diachronic answerability directly.
Defined over declared coverage, proved from a checkable certificate, never assumed - the thread states its own discipline.
The cruxes every other line reads: compute level and updateful-versus-updateless stance decide what any proved result means for real systems.
The two choices are crisply posed; the sharpest crux (do unbounded idealizations transfer at all) is named but the thread has no page organizing positions on it.
The top frame: everything proved, filed or decided hangs under one of its seven lines by the map's own convention.

The question (develop in line with humanity's interests without control, with mathematical guarantees) is stated in one sentence; 'in line with humanity's interests' carries the weight the lines exist to unpack.

Re-estimated after reading the note rather than the blurb: the transform and Theorem 2.4 are derived in value-change-as-epistemic-update.md and the finite claims are machine-checked (clean-room package corr-value-change, 1361 declarations, gate PASS), with exact fixtures; unregistered, and the thesis-level reading (carrying to trained systems) stays open.

Re-estimated: the map files this as the base of the value-change-base-layer programme, one sub-frame of the corrigibility landscape; the kernel route through response authority does not rest on it, so it is one route's foundation, not the line's sole wager.

Re-estimated against the note: the four-pictures structure, the explicit AUTHOR/CLAUDE registers, the non-realist framing in position-statement.md section 2.2 and the wiki page now summarizing them pin the thesis well; the non-uniqueness of the decomposition is stated rather than hidden.
